title: Clinging to other vehicles.
bodyText: No person riding upon a motorcycle shall attach oneself or the motorcycle to any other vehicle on a roadway.
bodyHtml: [§291C-154]  Clinging to other vehicles.  No person riding upon a motorcycle shall attach oneself or the motorcycle to any other vehicle on a roadway. [L 1971, c 150, pt of §1; gen ch 1985]
